The Baffler reviews Gil Durán's new book on Silicon Valley's hard-right political turn, tracing how venture capital figures poured hundreds of millions into capturing public offices.

The Bright Side:
Rigorous journalistic exposure breaks through tech marketing myths to reveal the raw financial interests behind reactionary politics.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
No structural deception in the essay. It accurately deconstructs the oligarchic switch from utopian rhetoric to anti-democratic power consolidation.

Social Physics Analysis:
Oligarchs justify political capture using pretexts of technological acceleration, projecting disruption onto public institutions while insulating their private capital from democratic accountability.

The Trajectory: Awakening into Grace.
By systematically exposing corporate pretexts, the analysis pushes civic discourse out of passive acceptance toward active resistance.

The Unavoidable Truth: Concentrated billionaire capital inherently strains democratic governance.

The Unavoidable Lie: Silicon Valley deregulation is driven by concern for human freedom.
